chairman.name: Prakash Shrestha
chairman.title: Chairperson
chairman.message:
Namaste,

A cooperative begins with people who decide to look after something together. It might be a first savings account, a family farm or a small shop on the corner.

Our role is to listen, explain the choices clearly and help members make plans they understand. That includes being open about rates, fees and the responsibilities that come with borrowing.

Members should have a voice in how their cooperative works. Regular conversations, clear records and a willingness to answer difficult questions are part of that responsibility.

Thank you for taking a little time to explore Mero Sahakari. This sample website shows how a cooperative can make its services easier to understand and its people easier to reach.

With warm regards,
